questions.question: Against whom is the oracle in Ezekiel 29?
To what creature is Pharaoh compared in Ezekiel 29?
options: A tall and towering cedar of the deep forest
An eagle soaring high above the lofty mountain peaks
The great dragon (sea monster) lying in his streams
A great lion crouching low within the thicket
questions.answer: The great dragon (sea monster) lying in his streams
